seo.title: Jackson House | Woodinville Restaurant & Craft Cocktail Bar
seo.description: Discover Jackson House in Woodinville, WA: seasonal dining, craft cocktails, weekly events, and memberships. Reserve your table today.

hero.title: Welcome to Jackson House
paragraphs: Jackson House is a beautifully appointed dining room and whiskey-driven bar and lounge. We celebrate the best of the Pacific Northwest through intricately crafted cocktails, seasonally driven cuisine, and warm hospitality.
Our Dining Room offers a full-service restaurant experience with locally inspired, chef-driven artisanal plates designed to be shared (or not).

Our Bar & Lounge features a relaxed, small-bite-focused, self-service format, with approachable team members ensuring a smooth experience. Join us midweek for gathering nights, including Vinyl Night on Thursdays. Visit on Wednesdays for Mystery Flight Night (guess all three pours correctly for a bonus pour) and half-price bottled wine.
Reservations are available in the dining room, or stop by and enjoy our lounge experience without a reservation.

reviews.author: Katy T.
reviews.text: We celebrate our 19th anniversary here and if we could give 10/5 stars, we would.

reviews.author: K I.
reviews.text: The food was exquisite. They thought of all the details. Very good ambience, great date night spot in Woodinville.

reviews.author: Anthony P.
reviews.text: What a great hidden gem in Woodinville.

reviews.author: Jeff K.
reviews.text: One of the best craft cocktail programs in the area.

reviews.author: Dana S.
reviews.text: The food was some of the most unique and delicious food we’ve had in the area. The lamb chops, caesar salad, and mushrooms were our favorites, but everything was so good. Highly highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tanner E.
reviews.text: Food, service and atmosphere were fantastic. I have been here twice now and both times I feel right at home.

reviews.author: Megan T.
reviews.text: The food is excellent. The vibe is very cute and moody in the best way, almost like a modern speakeasy, and the staff made my time very special.
